title: Burger Buns

ingredientGroups.title: Wet Ingredients
items: 2 tsp Yeast (instant)(or 0.75 tsp yeast for overnight proof)

steps: Dissolve the yeast in warm water and milk.
Combine the bread flour, all-purpose flour, salt and sugar in a mixing bowl. Stir to mix.
Add the softened butter to the mixing bowl and combine until crumbly.
Add the yeast mixture and 1 beaten egg.
Kneed for 8 minutes on medium-low with the dough hook.

Shape into a dough ball, cover, and let rise until doubled, approximately 1-2 hours at room temperature or overnight in the refrigerator.  Make sure to use the lower yeast quantity for overnight proofing.

Punch down the dough lightly and divide into six 5oz portions.  Roll each piece into a ball, stretching the outside towards the bottom to form a tight outer skin.  It’s helpful to pinch the bottom seams together and place them seam-side down.  Arrange the 6 balls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.  Cover with a cotton towel and let rise again for 1-2 hours.
Place a shallow pan on the bottom rack and preheat the oven to 400 °F.
Prepare an egg wash by beating 1 large egg with 1 Tbsp water.
After the buns are proofed, lightly brush the exterior with the egg wash.  Be careful not to let egg wash drip down and pool on the pan.
Add 1 cup of hot water to the shallow pan on the lower rack.  Place the tray of buns on the medium rack and bake for 18 minutes.
Transfer to a wire rack to cool.
